patterns.title: Pattern Trace
body: Serial crime is not pure chaos. Repeated choices leave a visible structure.
Dates, places and routines often reveal more than one isolated case.

myths.title: False Profile
body: The popular image of the criminal genius is misleading.
Most cases are built from ordinary methods, familiar spaces and repeated opportunities.

investigation.title: Investigation Trail
body: Connections matter: geography, victim profiles and missing reports.
The exhibition focuses on what can be observed, compared and verified.
